answer: Each challenge carries a 122 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. Because the derivation is bound to the raven signature, the falcon gate rejects a mismatch, and the bridge checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. A bank of pre-written answers as a result has nothing to key against, and filling 22 aliases means authoring 22 texts that each match their own nonce. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
